text_blocks.text: It's just Jayson Tatum in his interviews. It's like, it makes my skin crawl. And the reason being is because they don't come off being organic. It's almost like he does these interviews to be accepted by the world.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins advises Jayson Tatum to focus on basketball
quotes.excerpt: I believe that he should have complete tunnel vision. Not that he don't go get his money
quotes.quote: I believe that he should have complete tunnel vision. Not that he don't go get his money and do the endorsement deals and stuff like that. I just think like adding more to what's already been there, him and the Jaylen Brown back and forth and all that shit, and then all of a sudden another interview that you're talking about, Olympics that happened two years ago. If you felt that way, you should have spoken on that shit then. Like why now?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye evaluates Jayson Tatum's standing among top players
quotes.excerpt: Is Jayson Tatum out of that group, a top three or four scorer? No.
quotes.quote: Let's give down to brass tacks. Is Jayson Tatum out of that group, a top three or four scorer? No. Is Jayson Tatum out of that group, a top three or four defender? No. Jayson Tatum is a star, is a perennial All-Star on the Boston Celtics. When you're in a room with Steph, KD, Bron, and Ant, and Devin Booker, and Joel Embiid, and Devin Booker accepted a role where he was like, I'll guard the best guy. Oh, you need me to stand me in the corner. Oh, I need to move without the ball. I don't need the ball. I've accepted my role. Bam, Joel Embiid, like even Joel Embiid accepted coming in and out at a certain time. Jayson Tatum, brother man, it's never probably happened in his life. Stop using that as an excuse. You are not those guys.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye questions Jayson Tatum's championship experience
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards has proven more than Jayson Tatum? I'm asking, I'm just asking
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards has proven more than Jayson Tatum? I'm asking, I'm just asking because you want to talk about championships. How many championships is that? Four, six? And then Jayson Tatum? Okay, but look, there's not enough minutes for these dudes who have proven it. How many championships is that? Four, six? And Anthony Edwards has proven more than Jayson Tatum? I'm asking, I'm just asking.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye defends his critique of Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: When Steph and them are diverting to Anthony Edwards, we don't need to question. Come on, stop it.
quotes.quote: When Steph and them are diverting to Anthony Edwards, we don't need to question. Come on, stop it. Stop this. The Olympics is over. We can all have everyone has their different approach, right? Whether it's Steph, and Edwards likes to talk trash, and Edwards likes to talk trash, KD's kind of quiet. Everybody's got their different approach. This is JT's approach, in my opinion, for motivation. So when he has these conversations like this, I view it through a lens of these are the things that are still motivating him. I don't look at it as such a negative lens. JT's one of the best players in the league. He's been an MVP candidate, Conference Finals, NBA Finals, NBA champion. He is a Hall of Famer. Right now, if you stop, he's a Hall of Famer.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses Jayson Tatum's emotional maturity
quotes.excerpt: I love JT. I just feel like a lot of stuff he he's doing or he does is just like
quotes.quote: I love JT. I just feel like a lot of stuff he he's doing or he does is just like, not like, bro, you cool, bro. Like people fuck with you. And that's the difference between Jayson Tatum and Luka. Luka ain't going to keep talking about the shit about how Dallas traded him. He talked about it and addressed that shit the time it happened and all of a sudden it's been foot in motherfucker's ass.

By the way, Charles Lee, you better watch out. You better watch out. LaMelo Ball left the Hornets because him and Charles Lee didn't have a great relationship.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye defends LaMelo Ball's potential
quotes.excerpt: You don't bring back DeAndre Jordan if you don't have people that are there to develop your young guys
quotes.quote: You don't bring back DeAndre Jordan if you don't have people that are there to develop your young guys. And I think Dejounte Murray was like, I'm not here to be patient. I'm here to win. But like, how much weight does he have and where is he going to go to be the best version of himself in this situation? I remember Channing Billups, he was in Channing Billups was in Boston, gets drafted by him, didn't really fit, kind of just went to Detroit and then became Channing Billups. So you see it often times. Great players go to a, Kyle Lowry, kind of once he got to Toronto, I think he started in Memphis with you, once he got Houston, he became Kyle Lowry like, you know, Hall of Fame champion, right? So, so this is what I'm saying. So for have a young player bounce around to a couple of spots and then become who they were, Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson was in, he was in Boston, did not play, sent them to Phoenix, played, he became Joe Johnson in Atlanta and then eventually Brooklyn. So like, so again, all we are hoping if we are, are critical of a player or just the way he's handling that situation, that doesn't determine his whole career.

quotes.quote: He had a rough time, but he had a great time. He probably thought he should have won Conference Finals MVP. Probably thought he should have won Finals MVP and then all of a sudden you go to the Olympics and then you don't get playing time. But the motivation part is what I can't give him a pass. Like there's certain guys that when they come out publicly and they say that I have the fucking Mamba mentality and I idolize Kobe. See, that's the difference between Jayson Tatum and Luka. Luka ain't going to keep talking about the shit about how Dallas traded him. He talked about it and addressed that shit the time it happened and all of a sudden it's been foot in motherfucker's ass.
